version: 0.50.2

description: Goal mode now reports elapsed time and token usage, mobile sessions can be renamed, plus a batch of Goal mode, Codex image generation, and onboarding fixes.
---
### New

- Goal mode now reports elapsed time and token usage for each run.
- The mobile session header menu now includes a Rename action.

### Fixes and Improvements

- Cleaned up the Goal mode UI so the layout no longer renders out of order.
- Fixed an occasional hang in Goal mode.
- Fixed Codex image generation sometimes returning no image.
- Fixed onboarding stalling while waiting for Agent configuration.
- Fixed truncated model names in the model picker.
- Insert and cancel controls in the message queue are now always visible, not only on hover.
